def node(rel,name):
    found = [n for n in ast.walk(trees[rel]) if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.ClassDef)) and n.name == name]
    assert len(found)==1,(rel,name)
    return found[0]

def calls(n,name):
    return [x for x in ast.walk(n) if isinstance(x,ast.Call) and ((isinstance(x.func,ast.Name) and x.func.id==name) or (isinstance(x.func,ast.Attribute) and x.func.attr==name))]

def text(n):
    return ast.unparse(n)

def constants(rel):
    out = {}
    for n in trees[rel].body:
        if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and isinstance(n.value,ast.Constant):
            for target in n.targets:
                if isinstance(target,ast.Name):
                    out[target.id] = n.value.value
    return out
